section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for a single study (Study X) conducted at a regional college in the northeastern United States. The sample consisted of N = 261 undergraduate students with a mean age of 20.16 years, 60.9% identifying as women, and racially/ethnically diverse composition (44.4% European American/White, 20.3% Asian American, 17.6% African American, 8.0% Latino/a American, and 9.6% other). The sample size was determined based on literature suggesting correlations stabilize at approximately 250 participants.
